_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Jumaxa Jugador {player_id} uka {num_players}-jugador Liar's Dice pukllaypi.
Q'awa:
- Q'umirin q'illqay, jumaxa uka:
  1) Musphay bid mä q'umirin q'illqay uka alaxpacha q'umirin q'illqay uka ch'iqpacha face (ukaxa isinakata) q'umirin q'illqay '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Q'umirin q'illqay uka chiqpacha bid istha '[Call]'.

Jumaxa istha:
  - Juk'ampi uka face uñt'ayni tunka tunka waranqa, q'umirin q'illqay uka chiqpacha bidder mayni mayt'as waranqa tunka.
  - Ukaxa, istha irpiri mayni mayt'as waranqa tunka.
Jugador uka 0 tunka waranqa q'ara, ukaxa walikiña. Qhana jugador q'ara, ukaxa q'ara.

board.new_round:
Jani pacha utji - Jani q'ala wali: {dice_summary}
Jani jaqituqo sata sapa q'ala wali: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Player {current_player_id} q'epi! Jik'itana actual count-ita uka face {face_value} uka {count}, uka LESS uka {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (last bidder) loses one die.
call.caller_loses:
Player {current_player_id} q'epi! Jik'itana actual count-ita uka face {face_value} uka {count}, uka >= uka {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (caller) loses one die.

invalid_move.not_recognized: Aka jani utji jani pacha uta '[Bid: X, Y]' uta '[Call]'. Jani utji aka: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Jani wali {new_quantity} jani pacha utji jani wali {current_quantity}.

outcome.win: Jaqi {winner} jani utji! Jani pacha uta ranking: {final_ranking}
